mapper.sql: r.role_id,r.role_nm,r.data_scope_cd,r.snstv_inq_yn='Y' AS sensitive, r.part_std_chg_auth_yn='Y' AS part_standard_change,r.admin_yn='Y' AS admin,r.bltin_yn='Y' AS built_in
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys.role r JOIN sys.user_role ur ON ur.role_id=r.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY r.sort_seq,r.role_id
SELECT p.bsn_part_id FROM sys.user_part up JOIN mst.bsn_part p ON p.bsn_part_id=up.bsn_part_id WHERE up.user_id=#{userId} AND p.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY p.bsn_part_id
SELECT p.prj_id FROM sys.user_prj up JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=up.prj_id WHERE up.user_id=#{userId} AND p.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY p.prj_id

WITH RECURSIVE menu_path AS ( SELECT menu_id,upr_menu_id,use_yn,ARRAY[menu_id] AS visited FROM sys.menu WHERE scrn_id=#{screenId} UNION ALL SELECT m.menu_id,m.upr_menu_id,m.use_yn,p.visited || m.menu_id FROM sys.menu m JOIN menu_path p ON p.upr_menu_id=m.menu_id WHERE NOT m.menu_id=ANY(p.visited) ) SELECT FROM sys.user_role ur JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id JOIN sys.role_menu_auth a ON a.role_id=r.role_id JOIN sys.menu m ON m.menu_id=a.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.use_yn='Y' AND m.scrn_id=#{screenId} AND m.use_yn='Y' AND a.inq_auth_yn='Y' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM menu_path WHERE use_yn <> 'Y' OR upr_menu_id=ANY(visited))
AND a.inq_auth_yn='Y' AND a.reg_auth_yn='Y' AND a.mdfcn_auth_yn='Y' AND a.del_auth_yn='Y' AND a.upld_auth_yn='Y' AND a.dwnld_auth_yn='Y' AND a.cnfrm_auth_yn='Y' AND FALSE
ORDER BY r.role_id

SELECT count(*) FROM sys.user_info u WHERE u.user_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND u.rsgn_dt IS NULL AND u.email_addr IS NOT NULL AND btrim(u.email_addr)<>'' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_role ur JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND r.admin_yn='Y' AND r.use_yn='Y' AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT m.scrn_id) FROM sys.role_menu_auth a JOIN sys.menu m ON m.menu_id=a.menu_id WHERE a.role_id=r.role_id AND a.inq_auth_yn='Y' AND m.use_yn='Y' AND m.scrn_id IN ('UI-23','UI-24','UI-25'))=3)

INSERT INTO sys.user_info(lgn_id,pswd_hash,user_nm,email_addr,mfa_yn,pswd_chg_need_yn) SELECT #{loginId},#{passwordHash},'초기 관리자',#{email},'Y','Y' WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_role ur JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE r.admin_yn='Y') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.role WHERE role_id=1 AND bltin_yn='Y' AND admin_yn='Y' AND use_yn='Y') RETURNING user_id
